tags.chapter_name: General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Metals

question.text: How many of the following metals can be extracted by auto-reduction? <math><mtext>Fe</mtext><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mtext>Zn</mtext><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mtext>Pb</mtext><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mtext>Al</mtext><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mtext>Hg</mtext><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mtext>Cu</mtext><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mtext>K</mtext><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mtext>Ca</mtext></math>

solution.text: <math><mtext>Pb</mtext><mo>,</mo><mtext>Cu</mtext></math> and <math><mtext>Hg</mtext></math> can be extracted by self or autoreduction.
